Synopsis:
    Belgium's football federation (RBFA) is withholding support for FIFA President Infantino's reelection bid, citing unresolved concerns over the suspension of Folarin Balogun's red-card ban — a decision influenced by President Trump — which allowed Balogun to play against Belgium in the 2026 World Cup. The RBFA is demanding transparency on this case and on FIFA Forward Enterprise governance, and has requested the matter be placed on the October 15 FIFA Council agenda. UEFA is aligned with Belgium on these concerns.
